QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] The Straight-Faced Princess
QuestInfo.0: You're at the Mushroom Castle Banquet Hall, which is bustling with activity. Ask the Mushking what the occasion is.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: The Mushking welcomed you to the Mushroom Castle. He will be holding a competition to find a husband for Princess Violetta, who will also someday inherit the throne. Unfortunately, the competition is only open to mushrooms. Whew. You can still speak to the princess, however. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: Violetta seemed quite overwhelmed with the competition, despite the Mushking's wish to make her smile. The thought of her smiling makes you want to hurl a bit.

default.0: Don't look directly at the princess. Her bewitching charms take but moments to seize your heart.
